obligations.description: Retry only network failures, 429, and 5xx; redirects terminal without following.

alternatives.quote: Retry network failures, 429, and all 5xx responses.
Other 4xx responses are terminal; 2xx responses acknowledge delivery.
Redirect responses are terminal and must not be followed.

obligations.description: Six total attempts including initial send with configured backoff.

alternatives.quote: Attempt counts include the first send; stop at max_attempts.

obligations.description: 429 integer Retry-After overrides backoff up to 900 seconds; not used for 503.

alternatives.quote: For 429, a valid integer Retry-After replaces backoff, capped by config.
The header is ignored for statuses other than 429.

obligations.description: Keep the persisted event id across attempts with at-least-once semantics.

alternatives.quote: X-Event-Id is the persisted event id and is unchanged on every attempt.
Delivery remains at-least-once; receivers should deduplicate by that id.
A stable X-Event-Id identifies one event across all delivery attempts.
An acknowledgement lost in transit can cause another delivery.

obligations.description: Recheck lifecycle at execution and cancel deletion-state transfers without final contact.

alternatives.quote: Any outward transfer must recheck account state at execution time.
When state is deleting or removed, cancel queued outward transfers.
Do not send one final webhook to announce account deletion.
